abstract: The suction air channel is connected to a vacuum-producing source. In the suction air channel (2) a tappet (3) is arranged which in the presence of a vacuum in the suction channel is adjustable from a rest position into a work position in which the tappet (3) operates a valve or an approximation switch. The tappet is a component of a piston (5) which is displaceable in a housing bore (6, 7) crosswise to the suction air channel (2), whereby the face side of the piston turned away from the tappet is connected to the atmosphere via housing apertures (8). USE/ADVANTAGE - A suction grip for lifting and retaining flat piece goods, in the suction air channel of which is a tappet which operates a positioning component.
